stem_book: Find the sum to n terms of the series 1 × 3 × 5 + 3 × 5 × 7 + 5 × 7 × 9 + …
reason: print's last term 'n(n+1)(n+4)' contradicts the series (general term is (2n−1)(2n+1)(2n+3)), corrected to 'to n terms'; printed key sums k(2k+1)(2k+3) (gives 85 at n=2), true sum 15+105 = 120 = n(2n³+8n²+7n−2)
